!Sample_data_processing = All microarray expression analysis was performed using R. The R package “affy” was used to read in probe intensity data, and the Robust Multi-Array Average (RMA) procedure from the “affy” package was used for background correction, quantile normalisation and probeset summarization. Data for platform GPL570 was normalized with a subset of data from GSE36133 (see supplementary file on Series record)and processed with ComBat to remove batch effects.
